concepts.statement_en: Frame the concern with affected residents rather than deciding for them.
Separate reported observations from assumptions and identify missing perspectives.
Use community participation to identify needs, local solutions and ways to review results.
Invite affected residents, trusted conveners and relevant stakeholders beyond established leaders.
Agree accessible timing, location and communication options with participants.
Invite voluntary participation without conditional service access or promised attendance rewards.
Build trust through respectful discussion, suitable meeting arrangements and kept commitments.
Invite contributions and resolve disagreement without imposing one person’s preference.
Consider existing groups and agree willing members’ roles in a community core group.
Agree a feasible action with an owner, confirmed resources and timing.
Follow up commitments respectfully and resolve barriers with participants.
Review a meaningful result with residents and adapt the next action rather than counting attendance alone.
